name: Luther Reeve
source:
Former officer of the United Government's Special Operations Unit hired by [url=/c146899]Cymhen[/url] as my bodyguard. The only person to serve in the SOU without having the Affinity, he is widely regarded both for his proficiency with firearms and for his talent in developing containment strategies for mages of any and all specialties.
